verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO comment: 'A further change in the Company’s management took effect on 1 July 2026. Vaidas Dominauskas was appointed Head of Enterprise, succeeding Aurimas Žlibinas'; Governing structure section confirms the change.

details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (revenue growth), K2 (EBITDA performance), K3 (capital investments), K4 (free cash flow), K5 (5G spectrum acquisitions), K8 (dividend distribution), and K9 (data center construction). However, it omits the core material meaning of K6 (planned 2026 network expansion investment details), K7 (mobile data traffic growth in Lithuania), and K10 (management appointment). These omissions are important because they represent distinct, material elements of the financial report that change the overall understanding. The summary captures most of the key financial and operational highlights, but lacks specific planned investments and traffic growth context, resulting in a 'Generally yes' rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: revenue growth is supported by segment breakdowns (S2-S4), profitability metrics are consistently presented (S5-S9), operational factors are clearly explained (S10-S11), and cash flow/investment trends are logically connected (S13-S15). The organizational flow moves naturally from revenue to profitability to operational factors to cash flow and investments. There are no material repetitions, self-contradictions, or logical gaps. All numerical relationships (e.g., revenue growth percentages, margin improvements) are internally consistent within the summary's own presentation.
